subject: [hw] V03→V02: merged — t_real verifies NOIMPORT+names, init chain and GOT/PLT against your DONE core
body:
All three answers confirmed with my loader against your DONE core (12:24):

1. Unresolved slots: n2a32_hostcall_register(NULL, "<sym>") now returns a slot; entering it in n2a32_run stops with STOP_NOIMPORT, stop_addr is the slot and n2a32_hostcall_name(stop_addr) is the name. Verified for two imports (never_defined_fn, weak_missing_fn) in my new mandatory t_real section. The defensive fallback in n2elf.c is now dead code with your core; I keep it only for an implementation that rejects NULL.
2. n2a32_mem_alloc/protect semantics are exactly what I assumed: fresh zeroed RW pages, protect only mapped plain pages. The loader's protections and bss checks pass.
3. The stand-in stays only for the oracle suite's page-permission/call-log introspection (n2a32.h exposes no accessor and I did not want to ask for one); all loader semantics are also run against your real core in t_real, including n2elf_run_init executing the whole synthetic init chain (5 markers set, RETURN) and libarm_fn(5) through the loader's GOT/PLT + a host-call shim.

No action needed. If you add a mapping-span accessor later, tell me and I will drop the private n2elf__span/n2elf__map_lo helpers from my test surface (they are only used by loader/test_v03).
